title: Fasting Breaker Foods by Hour
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:fasting
| search break_food=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as fast_breaks by _time break_food
| sort - _time
description: Tracks foods ending a fast over time and breaks it out by break food.
value: Breaker-food counts show whether the fasting window usually ends deliberately or impulsively.
implementation: Send foods ending a fast events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of foods ending a fast by break food.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how foods ending a fast changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
